All murmurings.

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source("../R/tags.R")

dirs <- list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
dirs <- sort(dirs[file.exists(file.path(dirs, "index.Rmd"))], decreasing = TRUE)

# Staged release: hide posts whose folder date hasn't arrived yet.
# (Deployment also excludes these folders — see .github/workflows/deploy.yml —
# so unpublished posts are neither listed nor reachable by direct URL.)
dir_dates <- as.Date(substr(dirs, 1, 10), format = "%Y-%m-%d")
dirs <- dirs[is.na(dir_dates) | dir_dates <= Sys.Date()]

# Strict date order throughout — a post's tag is shown as a hashtag next
# to it (linking to its /tags/ archive page) rather than grouping posts
# under a heading, so a post never gets stranded under an earlier
# occurrence of a shared tag.
year <- NULL
for (dir in dirs) {
  meta <- read_post_meta(file.path(dir, "index.Rmd"))
  if (is.null(meta)) next

  post_year <- as.numeric(strsplit(meta$date, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1])

  if (is.null(year) || post_year != year) {
    if (!is.null(year)) cat("\n:::\n\n")
    year <- post_year
    cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n::: {.post-list}\n\n", year))
  }

  cat(sprintf("- %s [%s](%s/index.html)%s\n",
              meta$date, meta$title, dir, tag_links_md(meta$tags)))
}
if (!is.null(year)) cat("\n:::\n")
```
